dedupe_keys.name: ambae vanuatu 2017 2018 eruption tephra fall building damage survey of 589 buildings

description: This dataset gives the damage survey of 589 buildings affected by the 2017 to 2018 eruption of Manaro Voui on Ambae island, Vanuatu, as supplementary material to a study of tephra fall damage. It was deposited in DR-NTU (Data) at Nanyang Technological University by Susanna Jenkins and made available on 18 July 2024. For each building it gives the survey location, construction type, tephra thickness and damage state; coordinates, detailed damage descriptions and photos are withheld to protect the privacy of those affected. Coverage: 589 buildings on Ambae. Access: one table from DR-NTU. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0; free for non-commercial use. Caveats: no coordinates, so the data cannot be mapped at building level. Simulation uses: tephra fall fragility by construction type in small-island settings. Related records: the Taal 2020 tephra fall fragility data.
name: Ambae (Vanuatu) 2017-2018 eruption tephra fall building damage survey of 589 buildings
